sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Six robbers armed with guns and knives boarded the ship underway and entered the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered resulting in the robbers escaping with stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to the Singapore VTIS, who then dispatched the police for investigation.
